programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: Deep in the foothills of the Appalachian Mountains, a Georgia family is building a remote A-frame cabin retreat.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete creates an off-the-grid escape that's all about peace, love, and treehouses, man; building a stunning treehouse made from re-purposed materials, while the client, Sarah Jay, adds her own touch - a massive dream net hammock in the trees.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete partners up in Utopia, Texas, for his first joint venture: a tree house bed-and-breakfast built for romance; a French-inspired chapel of love has a 25-foot steeple and the biggest bathroom Pete has built to date.

programs.title: Treehouse Masters
programs.desc: Pete treks to New York's Catskill Mountains to build his first glass house in the sky; piecing materials together like a puzzle, Pete uses his clients' collection of 50 vintage windows to construct an elegant tree house encased by walls of glass.

programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.desc: Adrienne and Steve are seeking a vacation home in St. Joe Beach, Fla.; they find a house with potential, but it needs extensive renovations; unforeseen structural issues and budget concerns threaten to throw a wrench in their plans.

programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: From Lifeless Studs to a Modern Beach House
programs.desc: A Connecticut house flipper is on the hunt for a property with a beach view that he can call his own; after years of renovating houses for others to use, he is ready to find a vacation home that he and his family can escape to for some quality time.
